Class BamWriter

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.exporters.BamWriter
Direct Known Subclasses:
CramWriter
public class BamWriter extends Object
BAM exporter — M88.

v1.5.0 swapped the previous samtools subprocess approach for htsjdk's pure-Java SAM/BAM/CRAM writers (used by GATK, Picard, IGV). No external binary required; tio-browser works on Windows without a system samtools install. SAM line semantics still match the SAMv1 specification.

Quality byte encoding

M87's BamReader stores SAM's QUAL field bytes verbatim into WrittenGenomicRun.qualities() — i.e. the buffer holds ASCII Phred+33 characters (so a Phred-40 score is stored as the byte value 73, the ASCII code for 'I'). This writer mirrors that convention: each qualities[i] byte is interpreted as ASCII Phred+33 on write, then converted to raw Phred for htsjdk's SAMRecord.setBaseQualities(byte[]) (which expects raw bytes). The all-0xFF sentinel produced by the reader when source SAM had QUAL '*' maps back to "no qualities" via SAMRecord.NULL_QUALS.

Cross-language equivalents: Python ttio.exporters.bam.BamWriter, Objective-C TTIOBamWriter. Cross-language byte-equality on BAM output is verified by the cross-compat CI job.

(M88, v1.5.0 htsjdk swap)

  • Field Details

    • DEFAULT_SQ_LENGTH

      protected static final long DEFAULT_SQ_LENGTH
      Default @SQ LN: length when the writer doesn't know the true reference length. SAM requires LN: on every @SQ; we pick INT32_MAX so the emitted header is valid for any plausible coordinate. Matches the Python reference's _DEFAULT_SQ_LENGTH and the ObjC writer's constant for cross-language byte-equality.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • PROGRESS_INTERVAL_READS

      public static final int PROGRESS_INTERVAL_READS
      Stage D: emit-every-N cadence for ProgressSink callbacks during BAM/CRAM record serialisation. Mirrors BamReader.PROGRESS_INTERVAL_READS = 1000.

    • write

      public void write(WrittenGenomicRun run, List<ProvenanceRecord> provenance, boolean sort) throws IOException
      Serialise run to the configured output path.
      Parameters:
      run - the genomic-run container to write.
      provenance - optional provenance records to inject as @PG header lines. Pass an empty list for none.
      sort - when true, set @HD SO:coordinate so htsjdk's writer sorts records on close (precondition most downstream tools expect — IGV, GATK, samtools index). When false, output is unsorted.
      Throws:
      IOException - on write failures.

    • write

      public void write(WrittenGenomicRun run, List<ProvenanceRecord> provenance, boolean sort, ProgressSink progress) throws IOException
      Stage D overload of write(WrittenGenomicRun, List, boolean) that fires progress.onProgress(readsDone, totalReads) every PROGRESS_INTERVAL_READS records during the alignment write loop and a final onProgress(total, total) once the writer closes.

      total is known up front (= run.readNames().size()) so every mid-emit callback already passes the determinate total — listeners can drive a determinate progress bar from the first fire.

      Throws:
      IOException
      Since:
      1.5.0

    • makeWriter

      protected htsjdk.samtools.SAMFileWriter makeWriter(htsjdk.samtools.SAMFileHeader header, boolean sort)
      Build the SAMFileWriter for this output path + header. Default implementation produces BAM; CramWriter overrides to produce CRAM with a ReferenceSource.
      Parameters:
      header - the header (sort order already set).
      sort - whether output should be sorted on close. (presorted=false + header SO=coordinate triggers htsjdk's in-memory sort on close.)
